question: How does exile at Citrakūṭa coexist with lordship and martial prowess?
premises: He is lord of the world associated with the jewel-like mountain Citrakūṭa.
He is one who moves in battle.
Dwelling and warfare are both affirmed.
inference: Even in association with Citrakūṭa, he remains a world-lord and active warrior.
uncertainties: raṇecaraḥ may also suggest one who ranges on the battlefield.
plain_english: He is the lord of the world who gained the jewel-mountain Citrakūṭa and moves in battle.
